use_cases: Displaying a currency conversion interface with animated confirmation feedback
Showing exchange rate comparisons between two currencies with visual transition
Creating a payment confirmation card with SVG draw animation for the checkmark
Building international money transfer UI components in fintech applications
Adding animated transfer status indicators to payment dashboards
ai_summary: A currency transfer card component featuring an animated SVG checkmark with draw-in effect and tooltip support. The component uses motion/react for smooth animations, lucide-react icons for directional currency flow, and integrates with Card and Tooltip sub-components. Designed for fintech and e-commerce platforms requiring animated payment confirmations and currency exchange interfaces.
